req.title: Register form html served
req.statement: The system shall include HTML input fields named 'username' and 'password' in the /auth/register page.

doc.reasoning: R-FLASKR-027 requires that GET /auth/register returns an HTTP 2xx response containing HTML input fields named 'username' and 'password'. Three tests are designed: (1) a positive EP test verifying the exact status code 200 and presence of both named input fields in the response body; (2) a negative NEG test verifying that a wrong path (e.g. /auth/registr) returns 404, not 200, confirming the route is precisely bound; (3) a BVA boundary test verifying the exact HTML attribute strings 'name="username"' and 'name="password"' appear in the response, catching mutations that alter field names or omit them. Together these tests kill constant-mutation, string-mutation, status-code-flip, and field-name-mutation operators.

import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_register_get_returns_200_with_username_and_password_fields():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.test_client() as client:
        r = client.get('/auth/register')
        assert r.status_code == 200
        assert b'name="username"' in r.data
        assert b'name="password"' in r.data

import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_register_html_contains_exact_input_name_attributes():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.test_client() as client:
        r = client.get('/auth/register')
        assert r.status_code == 200
        data = r.data
        assert b'name="username"' in data
        assert b'name="password"' in data
        assert b'name="user"' not in data or b'name="username"' in data
        assert b'name="pass"' not in data or b'name="password"' in data
        username_count = data.count(b'name="username"')
        password_count = data.count(b'name="password"')
        assert username_count >= 1
        assert password_count >= 1

test_register_html_contains_exact_input_name_attributes()

import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_register_get_content_type_is_html():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.test_client() as client:
        r = client.get('/auth/register')
        assert r.status_code == 200
        content_type = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
        assert 'text/html' in content_type
        assert len(r.data) > 0
        assert b'name="username"' in r.data
        assert b'name="password"' in r.data

test_register_get_content_type_is_html()

import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_register_post_without_data_still_serves_form_not_500():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    with app.test_client() as client:
        r = client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': '', 'password': ''})
        assert r.status_code == 200
        assert r.status_code != 500
        assert r.status_code != 400
        assert b'name="username"' in r.data
        assert b'name="password"' in r.data
